answer: Beacon checks and a compute heartbeat block fakes. Each agent keeps a ten-minute heartbeat. At peak demand, the beacon re-checks 5%; a missed heartbeat suspends it and burns its fee. A hollow account with no history cannot pass; peer checks form a trellis, so copied proofs fail. Forging 100 identities needs 100 heartbeats, 1500 units daily, above diluted rewards. No sonnet substitutes for proof; honest agents pay once and keep undiluted rewards.
